items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: Sarah Vaughan was a very big influence on me in the early, when I was first working with Roy.

ctx.x: And your good buddy Sarah Vaughan.

Oh and Sarah Vaughan was a very big influence on me in the early, when I was first working with Roy. Because she was very hot then. She was just coming into prominence. And Dave Garroway is the one who dubbed her “The Divine One.” And he would talk about her all the time and play her records, and I said yeah, she’s great. I sounded like her for a while because sometimes inadvertently people you like, it rubs off on you you know. You’re not trying to copy them really, but it’s just a period of development you…
Yes. It’s a sincere form of flattery too.
